correctness.rationale: For two leaf-clique centroids, the within-clique variance lower bounds are a=(m−1)/(2m), b=(n−1)/(2n); upper own-hub/bridge lengths and lower cross-leaf distances force 9≤(sqrt(c²−a)+c+sqrt(c²−b))²+a+b. Strict decrease in variances and increase in c yield the unique optimal root. Orthogonal regular simplices on a collinear hub bridge achieve all pair bounds, including cross-hub lower distance two. Equality propagates to every leaf-edge length and cross-leaf distance; centering forces orthogonal simplex spans and an affine dimension m+n−1, hence congruence rigidity. Independent numerical root and pair-orbit checks covered unbalanced sizes and large examples, not infinite sizes.
